payload.title: Drupal scan runs out of heap in intra-component lineage scope cache
payload.description: CLI 0.0.28 scan of corpus repo drupal (229 files, 3 MB) exhausts a 2 GB heap in data_flow. Trigger: core/.phpstan-baseline.php (34k lines, no function headers). enclosingScopeFinder caches a scope text per header-less line that runs to EOF: quadratic memory.
